subject: MPA: security gate clarifications and data-handling retention plan
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@lendwise.com>, Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@lendwise.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: MPA: security gate clarifications and data-handling retention plan

Hi Samir / Alicia,

Thanks again for the time today — great to see alignment on product fit. As discussed, we want to capture the security/compliance gates inside the Mutual Action Plan (MPA) so we have a concrete close runway. Looping in Ben (security) and Marissa (solutions) to confirm technical details.

High-level asks from Lendwise that I captured:
- SOC 2: confirm whether you need an in-scope SOC 2 Type II report before go-live or if a current Type I plus remediation plan is acceptable for pilot.
- SIG/CAIQ completed matrix: Lendwise wants completed responses for high-priority modules (Data Protection, Infrastructure, Encryption) for the eval window.
- DPA redlines: you flagged two carve-outs on subprocessors and retention.
- Retention windows: define default data retention for user content, logs, and KV/prefix caches.

Proposed MPA milestones & tentative dates (we can shift based on your internal approvals):
1) SIG/CAIQ draft sent (you review): 2027-04-14
2) DPA redline exchange: 2027-04-16
3) SOC 2 evidence window (if required): 2027-04-19 -> 2027-04-30
4) Eval canary & data handling test: 2027-05-05 to 2027-05-07
5) Mutual sign-off / PO: target 2027-05-10

Acceptance criteria we propose to include in the MPA:
- SOC 2: either a Type II report covering Redwood production (or a signed remediation plan + milestones if Type II isn’t available by sign-off).
- SIG: responses for prioritized modules marked as "critical" by Lendwise must be completed and validated by your security team.
- DPA: agreed retention windows + subprocessors list; any carve-outs must be documented and limited in scope.

Ben / Marissa — can you confirm capacity to produce the SIG responses by 4/14 and whether you want Redwood to pre-populate the CAIQ for you? Also Ben, please confirm our standard retention defaults and options to extend to 90 / 365 days for logs/content.

Samir / Alicia — if any of the proposed dates are too aggressive please flag which ones to move out; happy to adjust.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@lendwise.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@lendwise.com>
Date: 2027-04-11T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MPA: security gate clarifications and data-handling retention plan

Hi Neha — thanks for the clear run-down. A few clarifications from Lendwise security before we lock dates: 

1) SOC 2: We need either an existing Type II report that covers the inference service or a vendor commitment and clear timeline to achieve Type II within 60 days of PO. A remediation plan is acceptable for the initial pilot only if we have a binding commitment and compensating controls documented.

2) SIG/CAIQ: we expect the CAIQ answers to be vendor-completed with supporting evidence (screenshots / architecture diagrams). Can you provide the matrix and a point of contact who will validate answers?

3) DPA: we will push back on any broad subprocessor language. Our legal team will redline for a 30/90/365 retention tier for different data classes — please confirm Redwood’s ability to set per-tenant retention at those tiers. Also request 90 days for Redwood to review your redline and provide counter-redline.

4) Acceptance: For go/no-go we require the SIG responses validated, DPA redlines materially agreed, and SOC 2 remediation milestones in place.

Can Ben/Marissa share the CAIQ file and the retention capabilities?

Thanks,
Samir
Director of IT Risk, Lendwise

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@lendwise.com>, Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@lendwise.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-12T10:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MPA: security gate clarifications and data-handling retention plan

Hi Samir / Alicia — thanks, quick answers inline and attachments included. Attaching: Lendwise_SIG_v5.xlsx (pre-populated CAIQ with evidence pointers) and DPA_redline_neha_v2.pdf (our suggested counter-redlines).

1) SOC 2
- Redwood currently has a SOC 2 Type II covering core storage & compute controls (report available on request). Our inference runtime is scoped; we can provide the latest report by 4/15. If Lendwise requires a contractual commitment to achieve additional control coverage, we can add milestone dates and escrow-like concessions in the MPA (we typically commit to a 60-day improvement window with progress checkpoints).

2) SIG/CAIQ
- Attached CAIQ is pre-populated with "answer + evidence pointer" (screenshots, docs, architecture pages). Marissa will be the CAIQ PO for validation — marissa.cole@redwood.ai.
- Proposed CAIQ timeline: Redwood sends pre-populated CAIQ (today 4/12), Lendwise validates by 4/14, Redwood provides any additional evidence by 4/16.

3) DPA & Retention
- Per-tenant retention: yes — Redwood supports configurable retention tiers by tenant. Default for user-generated content: 365 days. Logs: configurable, default 30 days.
- We will support 30 / 90 / 365 retention tiers for content and logs and document exact deletion semantics in the DPA.
- Subprocessors: we list all subprocessors in Annex A of the DPA; we can accept a carve-out for any single named subprocessors with bilateral approval.
- Timeline: send your legal redline; Redwood will provide a response within 7 business days (we set 4/16 as target but can extend to 4/23 if you need more review time).

4) Acceptance criteria (proposed final language for MPA)
- SIG: All "critical" questions answered and evidence linked. Lendwise security to validate in 48 hours per pre-agreed schedule.
- DPA: Agreement on retention tiers and subprocessors list. Limited carve-outs documented and approved.
- SOC 2: If Type II available, deliver report. If not, signed remediation milestones with checkpoints within 60 days.

Next steps we propose:
- (Today) Redwood -> send CAIQ + DPA redline (attached).
- (4/14) Lendwise -> CAIQ validation and legal redline submission (if possible).
- (4/16) Redwood -> final evidence + counter-redline or acceptance.
- (5/05-05/07) Technical canary: Redwood engineers will run a limited production-like inference test with synthetic data; logs/retention behaviors will be demonstrated.

If those timelines look good we can add them to the MPA and include the acceptance criteria so the procurement team has a clear close path.

Best,
Ben Carter
Head of Security, Redwood Inference

[Attachments: Lendwise_SIG_v5.xlsx (CAIQ pre-populated); DPA_redline_neha_v2.pdf (Redwood suggested DPA counter-redline)]

From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@lendwise.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@lendwise.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-13T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MPA: security gate clarifications and data-handling retention plan

Ben / Neha — this is helpful and addresses most of the outstanding questions. A couple of quick asks before we finalize the MPA: 

- Please confirm the exact SOC 2 report name & date when you send it (we need report name + coverage statement).
- For the canary (5/05-05/07), we want a short test plan (success criteria + data deletion verification steps). Can Marissa own the canary test plan?
- Legal will send a DPA redline by 4/14 EOD; please target a 7-business-day turnaround for counter-redline as Ben suggested.

We are comfortable targeting the 5/10 sign-off if the above are satisfied. Once we have the CAIQ validated and DPA redline exchanged, our procurement will draft the PO.

Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Alicia Gomez
Head of Procurement, Lendwise
